command: Four-drone coordination exercise: Relief UAV 07, Relief UAV 04, Relief UAV 10, and Relief UAV 01 take off together to 22 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (439, 513, 22), (648, 374, 22), (675, 563, 22), and (441, 637, 22) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all four drones move north for 102m, and next move east for 74m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 102m, then east 74m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
